supporting_observations.claim: The supplied evidence contains no account-creation event identifying tmp.rwong, its creator, or its initial group memberships. The alerted creation therefore cannot be independently verified or classified from these records.
lucy.park launched an RDP client targeting DC-HD-01 at 13:32 and initiated a connection to port 3389. These records do not establish a successful DC logon or any action involving tmp.rwong.

FILE-HD-01 recorded a successful remote-interactive logon by lucy.park from WS-LPARK-01 at 13:36:07. The subsequent shell processes ran under that logon, but these records do not link the session to tmp.rwong.

known_telemetry_limitations: No supplied record documents creation, modification, group membership changes, or authentication for tmp.rwong; there is consequently no record ID available to cite for the alerted action.
The supplied evidence contains no domain-controller security events establishing the creator or authorization context of the alerted account.
The RDP connection toward DC-HD-01 is visible only in source-side records; successful authentication and subsequent DC activity are not established (T008-00017, T008-00019).
No approval ticket or account-provisioning audit trail was supplied.
claims_not_established: Whether tmp.rwong was actually created around 13:42 UTC and by which security principal.
Whether the account was an authorized temporary account belonging only to Temp-Staff.
Whether the account received administrative rights or was subsequently used.
Whether lucy.park's RDP activity had any relationship to the account-creation alert.
Whether the alerted activity was malicious or benign.
additional_evidence_needed: Obtain the original alert's underlying event and DC-HD-01 Security event 4720 for tmp.rwong, including its SID, creator identity, subject logon ID, and timestamp.
Collect relevant account-change and group-membership events, including 4738, 4728, 4732, and 4756, and verify the account's effective privileges and memberships.
Correlate the creator's logon ID with DC authentication and administrative-process records during 13:20–14:20 UTC.
Obtain the temporary-account request and approval, intended owner, expiration, and confirmation from the authorized provisioning personnel.
Review authentication and resource-access records for tmp.rwong during the review window.
unrelated_findings: Separate ticket: lucy.park initiated RDP toward DC-HD-01 and successfully logged on remotely to FILE-HD-01 from WS-LPARK-01, contrary to the supplied restriction that remote administration originate only from WS-OHADDAD-01. Whether these sessions involved administrative actions is not established; no link to tmp.rwong is shown (T008-00017, T008-00019, T008-00030, T008-00031).

Separate ticket: Dropbox.exe executed under lucy.park, although Dropbox is not an approved cloud-storage service in the supplied inventory. These records do not establish file transfer or a connection to the alerted account (T008-00055, T008-00056).

Separate ticket: the GlobalProtect client executed under lucy.park despite the supplied no-VPN environment context. Execution alone does not establish an active VPN connection (T008-00072, T008-00073).
